purpose: new contact-dynamics stress tests; not original IROS trials or benchmark-wide superiority

geometry.targets: three blocks; smaller yellow block supported on red; separate magenta block; protected green vessel

prior: motor cap 0.8 N observed successful in three separate nominal-friction calibration episodes; no force override in evaluated runs
recovery: failure detected by bilateral tactile retention; retry only after release, retreat, two stable RGB-D observations and visible protected/completed objects; paper L1 force x1.2
recording: first declared seed in every condition, irrespective of outcome; raw simulator frames
